name: PERCH persona retrieval benchmark v1
note: A fictional person (Rohan Desai) with 68 memories across the six classes, and 112 questions labelled by hand. 'relevant' is what a good answer needs; 'ok' is acceptable context that is not counted as an intrusion. Written by the PERCH authors: directional evidence, not a published benchmark.

items.title: Who I am
items.body: Rohan Desai, final-year B.Tech Computer Science student at Northfield Institute of Technology, Bengaluru. Uses British spelling.

items.title: How I want answers written
items.body: Short and direct, no filler or hedging. Numbered steps for procedures, bullet points for lists. Code examples in Python unless another language is asked for.

items.title: Languages I speak
items.body: Fluent in English and Hindi, conversational Kannada. Writes to faculty formally in English.

items.title: Standing instructions
items.body: Always cite a source for factual claims and say plainly when unsure. Never invent numbers.

items.title: Email voice
items.body: Emails are polite and brief, three to five sentences, and sign off with 'Regards, Rohan'.

items.title: Time zone and working hours
items.body: Lives in IST. Works best late in the evening. Prefers deadlines written as dates, not weekdays.

items.title: Tidewatch: what it is
items.body: Tidewatch is a flood early-warning app for Bengaluru neighbourhoods, combining rainfall feeds with lake-level sensors. Stack: React Native app, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB.

items.title: Tidewatch: why TimescaleDB
items.body: Chose TimescaleDB over InfluxDB in July 2026 because alerts need SQL joins against ward boundary polygons, and one Postgres is simpler to run than two databases.

items.title: Tidewatch: duplicate push notifications
items.body: Alerts arrived twice on Android because the FCM token-refresh handler registered the device a second time. Fixed by upserting tokens keyed on device id.

items.title: Tidewatch: alert model accuracy
items.body: Gradient-boosted model trained on three years of IMD rainfall data. Recall 0.87 at a one-hour lead time; false alarms are the main concern.

items.title: Tidewatch: deployment
items.body: Runs with Docker Compose on a DigitalOcean droplet, Caddy terminating TLS. GitHub Actions deploys whenever a version tag is pushed.

items.title: Tidewatch: offline maps not done
items.body: Offline mode for the map is still open: tile caching with MapLibre has not been started.

items.title: Ledgerly: expense tracker
items.body: Ledgerly is a personal expense-tracker side project in Flutter with SQLite. It categorises spending by parsing UPI transaction SMS with regular expressions.

items.title: Ledgerly: HDFC SMS parsing bug
items.body: The SMS parser missed HDFC messages, which write amounts as 'Rs.' where others use 'INR'. Fixed by normalising currency prefixes before matching.

items.title: Ledgerly: no cloud sync
items.body: Decided Ledgerly stays local-only with no cloud sync, because it holds bank data.

items.title: Minnow compiler
items.body: Minnow is a toy-language compiler written in Rust with an LLVM backend, built as the minor project.

items.title: Minnow: LLVM version mismatch
items.body: The build failed because inkwell expected a different LLVM than the installed LLVM 17. Pinned inkwell 0.4 with the llvm17-0 feature.

items.title: Tidewatch: API rate limiting
items.body: After a scraper hammered the API in August 2026, added slowapi rate limiting at 60 requests per minute per IP.

items.title: Tidewatch: team
items.body: Kavya builds the frontend; Imran builds the ESP32 sensor hardware. Rohan owns the backend and the alert model.

items.title: Tidewatch: pilot results
items.body: Piloted in three wards during the August 2026 rains: 41 alerts sent, two of them false alarms.
